== Description ==
#ヘイデイ #HAYDAY - Hay Day Live Stream - June 8th 2018 - Hay Day Update, Birthday, iOS 9.x Chat & Play has Ricky Burnett aka R3DKNIGHT playing Hay Day. In this first of three hay day videos he talks about the June Update and speculates with you on what it could bring.

We chat about the Hay Day birthday and what we have had or may get this time. What would you like Hay Day to give us. What birthday event would you like to see. 

Note that the iOS 9.X is gonna be the only supported version Information listed below. 

Big thank you to the Hay Day team on joining the stream and answering questions. Read the chat for the replies

June 8th 2018 Part Two of Two


Don't forget to sub, like and comment below.

................... Supported version Information .............

With the next coming update to Hay Day (mid June), we will unfortunately have to end support for all Apple devices running on iOS versions lower than 9.x due to technical reasons beyond our control.

In order to keep playing Hay Day, please update to iOS version 9.x (or higher) as soon as possible (before Hay Day's next update). After the update, you won’t be able to play Hay Day unless you have updated to iOS 9.x or higher, or if your device does not support iOS 9.x or higher.

Apple devices which cannot update to iOS9.x or higher are: iPhone 4

Apple devices which originally shipped with a lower iOS version than 9.x, but can update to iOS9.x or possibly higher are:
iPhone 4S, iPhone 5, iPhone 5S, iPhone 6, iPhone 6 Plus, iPod Touch (5th generation)
iPod Touch (6th generation), iPad 2, iPad (3rd generation), iPad (4th generation)
iPad Air, iPad Air 2, iPad Mini, iPad Mini 2

Instructions on how to update your iOS can be found at Apple Support website: http://support.apple.com/HT204204

If you want to transfer your farm to a new device, please use the Supercell ID. How to use Supercell ID, please follow this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VymLtGx_itc
-Team Hay Day
